about:
Captor Corporation was established in 1965 in Tipp City, Ohio, by an engineering-oriented management team that included several experienced veterans. The founders brought deep expertise in electronic filters and military-aerospace communications, and early success allowed the company to build a dedicated manufacturing facility that has since expanded to 35,000 square feet.

The company designs and manufactures custom EMI and EMC filtering solutions, including TEMPEST, HEMP/EMP, and signal-line filters, as well as custom capacitors, inductors, coils, cable assemblies, wire harnesses, electromechanical box builds, and power distribution units. All engineering, production, and testing occur in-house at the Tipp City facility, which houses an advanced all-welded shielded room for pre-compliance testing. Captor has produced over 10,000 custom filter designs and focuses on low-to-medium-volume production.

Captor serves OEMs in aerospace, defense, secure communications, medical equipment, telecommunications, radar systems, and missile-launching programs. Its military-grade products meet MIL-STD-220, MIL-STD-461 CE102, and AS9100D requirements, and the company supplies cable assemblies for aerospace systems, military vehicle lighting, and other defense platforms.

The company emphasizes that custom solutions can be delivered faster and more cost-effectively than many competitors' catalog parts, with no added cost for tailoring. Its mission centers on producing the highest-quality EMI filters, exceeding customer expectations, and maintaining a safe, respectful workplace while continuously improving quality and profitability.
